backlogit_docs_lint MCP tool (and `docs lint`) fails on Windows with an absolute workspace root: `docs lint: docline.collectInScopeDocs: walk: Rel: can't make C:\Source\GitHub\backlogit relative to "."`. Reproduced repo-wide AND with a `path` argument. Root cause appears to be a walk that uses "." (relative) as the filepath.Rel base while the resolved workspace/target path is absolute, so filepath.Rel(".", absPath) errors on Windows. Impact: the docline frontmatter gate cannot be run via MCP on Windows (harvest Phase 1.5 / Stage plan self-lint must fall back to manual verification). Fix: resolve the Rel base to the same absolute root as the walked paths (or make both relative) in docline.collectInScopeDocs. Discovered during Stage session for feature 125-F on 2026-07-24 (backlogit v1.7.0, go1.24.13).

Provision the markdownlint tooling that policy P-008 already assumes. .github/policies/workflow-policies.md (P-008) states as a precondition that "The workspace has a .markdownlint.json config enabling MD001, MD025, MD041" and postconditions `markdownlint "**/*.md"` exits 0 — but the repo ships NO .markdownlint.json, no Makefile md-lint target, and no markdownlint CI job (only make docs / make docs-lint exist). So the P-008 markdown heading-hierarchy gate is not reproducible or CI-enforced; agents fall back to markdownlint environment defaults. Fix: add .markdownlint.json enabling exactly MD001/MD025/MD041, a Makefile target (e.g. md-lint) invoking markdownlint-cli2 (or equivalent), and a CI job so Ship and CI apply the same rules. Surfaced by PR #297 Copilot review of the 125-F docs-consistency plan (thread on U6 markdown-structure lint).
